item.title: Stuck in Paris traffic, she simply took off.
item.description:
Stuck in Paris traffic, she simply took off.
Seedance 2.5 turned a blood moon into her runway.
Prompt ⤵️ Photoreal dark-fantasy Paris Halloween: a red-haired vampire queen in black lace puts her silver car in flight mode, rockets off the jammed boulevard, corkscrews around the Eiffel Tower, barrel-rolls past a giant blood moon and lands at a gothic club, cape spread wide.
#AIvideo #Seedance #AIart #AIgenerated #texttovideo

item.title: She folded a paper crane and flew it home.
item.description:
She folded a paper crane and flew it home.
Seedance 2.5 painted every rain-soaked frame.
Prompt ⤵️ Painterly 2.5D gouache animation, rainy neon city: a young courier in a mustard-yellow raincoat breathes on a paper crane, it grows into a glider, she soars between neon towers and lands on an old man's warm balcony to hand him the crane. Tender, magical.
#AIvideo #Seedance #AIart #AIgenerated #texttovideo

item.title: A tiny rowboat, a raging storm, and then those jaws rise from below.
item.description:
A tiny rowboat, a raging storm, and then those jaws rise from below.
Every wave and every tooth here came out of Seedance 2.0.
Prompt ⤵️ Hyper-real storm at sea, cold blue tones: a lone man balances in a small wooden rowboat on huge swells when a colossal shark bursts up, jaws wide, bites the boat and drags it under, leaving only foam. Tense, cinematic.

item.title: One wild paint throw and the blank canvas becomes a mountain range.
item.description:
One wild paint throw and the blank canvas becomes a mountain range.

Prompt ⤵️ 3D animated film look, cozy studio: a curly-haired painter in round glasses hurls neon paint at a canvas, the rainbow swirl morphs into a snow-capped mountain painting, her orange cat yawns, she shrugs proudly. Playful, warm light.

item.description:
